how_to_find: Open your server health address (your Railway address plus /health) and read the version field. It shows the server version, for example 2.2.0. You can also read the newest commit date on your fork on GitHub and match it to a version below. The repository has no git tags (VERIFY).

versions.title: SDK upgrade for Streamable HTTP
versions.summary: Latest commit 3f7710b on branch master. Date taken from the commit. Server reports version 2.2.0. VERIFY: version grouping is inferred from commit dates, not from tags.

changes.text: Raised the MCP SDK to ^1.10.0 so StreamableHTTPServerTransport works (commit 3f7710b).

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: On GitHub, open your fork and click Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself. Then open the health address and check it returns status ok.
